text.p: Results in the latest round of Sunday League (40 overs) cricket matches:
At Edgbaston: Warwickshire beat Northamptonshire by 5 wickets. Northamptonshire 173-9 in 40 overs. Warwickshire (revised target 145 in 30 overs after rain interruption) 145-5 in 29.3 overs.

At Canterbury: Kent beat Surrey by 12 runs in match reduced to 25 overs because of rain. Kent 193-8 in 25 overs (G.Cowdrey 82; A.Hollioake 5-38). Surrey 181-8 in 25 overs (A.Brown 52; D.Headley 4-27).
At Chelmsford: Essex beat Middlesex by 66 runs. Essex 256 all out in 40 overs (D.Law 55; P.Weekes 4-38). Middlesex 190 all out in 37.5 overs (A.Cowan 4-31).

At Hove: Nottinghamshire beat Sussex by 6 wickets in match reduced to 28 overs because of rain. Sussex 160-7 in 28 overs (K.Greenfield 69 not out; K.Evans 4-26). Nottinghamshire 162-4 in 26.5 overs (P.Johnson 60, T.Robinson 51).
At Southampton: Yorkshire beat Hampshire by 71 runs. Yorkshire 227 all out in 39.3 overs (D.Lehmann; R.Maru 4-29). Hampshire 156 all out in 35.5 overs.
At Taunton: Somerset beat Glamorgan by 6 wickets. Glamorgan 207 all out in 40 overs (A.Cottey 61). Somerset 210-4 in 37.1 overs (M.Lathwell 72, R.Harden 50 not out).

At Derby: Lancashire beat Derbyshire by 35 runs. Lancashire 262-7 in 40 overs (G.Lloyd 81, N.Fairbrother 74). Derbyshire (revised target 252 in 38 overs after rain interruption) 217-9 in 38 overs (D.Jones 58).
